title: Mexican Millet Bake with French Twist
description: A creative Mexican dish featuring millet and a French touch of Madeleine cake. This gluten-free recipe is perfect for a warm and satisfying meal.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the cumin, chili powder, and salt. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes and salsa. Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, mix together the cooked millet, tomato mixture, and crumbled Madeleine cake.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is set.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
